verifiedAgainst: WordPress/gutenberg trunk, from each component's own Storybook `componentStatus` metadata, 2026-08-25
note: Component currency, not props. `status` says whether a component is the current best-practice choice: `recommended` (use it), `legacy` (works, but a recommended replacement now covers the job -- see `supersededBy`), `locked` (a private API Gutenberg explicitly does not recommend outside core -- can break without notice on any update), `experimental` (real, documented, but WordPress's own Storybook metadata (`componentStatus.status: 'use-with-caution'`) flags it not-yet-safe to mix with @wordpress/components -- true of almost every real WP admin codebase today, so treat as informational, not a migration target, until that gate lifts). Two components can share a name across packages with different status -- `Button` in `@wordpress/components` is `recommended` today while the newer `Button` in `@wordpress/ui` is `experimental`; check `package` too. This file is the canonical answer to 'is this the current best practice' -- the design-system MCP is for prop/usage detail on a component you've already chosen, and does not carry this maturity signal at all (it presents `experimental`-status components with the same confidence as `recommended` ones, and is itself measurably behind trunk for several @wordpress/ui additions: Dialog, AlertDialog, Drawer, IconButton, LinkButton, and the current Menu all return nothing from `get_component_details`). Re-verify against trunk (`packages/ui/src/*/stories/index.story.tsx` -> `parameters.componentStatus`) before bumping this file's version -- do not guess a status.

components.name: Grid
components.note: Planned for deprecation per its own Storybook status. Write the grid in CSS; if this is really a flex row or column it wanted Stack, not Grid.
components.supersededBy: CSS grid on a plain element

components.name: Spacer
components.supersededBy: Stack's gap prop, or a --wpds-dimension-gap-* token directly

components.name: Divider
components.note: Planned for deprecation per its own Storybook status.
components.supersededBy: a CSS border, or a Stack with a separator

variants.heading-2xl: Page title. 32px, semibold. One per screen, at the top.
variants.heading-md: Subsection title or group label. 13px, semibold: body size, set apart only by weight.
variants.heading-sm: Small overline or eyebrow label above a group. 11px, semibold.
variants.body-xl: Large lead or display copy. 20px, regular.
variants.body-md: Default body text: paragraphs, labels, values. 13px, regular.
variants.body-sm: Secondary text: help text, descriptions, captions, metadata, muted notes. 12px, regular.

components.name: Text
components.note: Same name, different package and prop surface -- @wordpress/ui's Text has only `variant`, no size/weight/color/align.

components.name: Heading
components.supersededBy: Text (@wordpress/ui) with variant="heading-*" and render for the semantic element

components.name: Truncate
components.note: No @wordpress/ui replacement yet.

components.name: Icon
components.note: Its own docs say to prefer it over @wordpress/components Icon or @wordpress/icons.

components.name: Badge
components.note: Private API -- Gutenberg does not yet recommend using this outside core.

components.name: Tabs
components.note: Private API -- Gutenberg does not yet recommend using this outside core.

components.name: Menu
components.note: Private API -- Gutenberg does not yet recommend using this outside core.

components.name: Menu
components.note: Real and documented, but Storybook flags it use-with-caution: APIs still in flux, compatibility with @wordpress/components overlays under review (gutenberg#76135).

components.name: Field
components.note: A low-level form primitive. Check for a higher-level *Control component (in either package) or DataForm first -- most UI should not need Field directly.

components.name: Fieldset
components.note: Same altitude caveat as Field -- for a group of controls sharing one legend, not a substitute for a *Control component.

components.name: Button
components.note: Still the safe, stable choice. @wordpress/ui's Button exists but is experimental (see below) -- not a migration target yet.

components.name: Button
components.note: Real and documented, but Storybook flags it use-with-caution: not yet recommended alongside @wordpress/components, pending style-consistency and text-overflow review (gutenberg#76135).

components.name: IconButton
components.note: Same use-with-caution gate as Button (@wordpress/ui) -- part of the same Button/IconButton/Link/LinkButton family, not yet safe alongside @wordpress/components.

components.name: LinkButton
components.note: Same use-with-caution gate as Button (@wordpress/ui).

components.name: Notice
components.note: Still the safe, stable choice. @wordpress/ui's Notice exists (compound Root/Title/Description/Actions) but is experimental -- not a migration target yet.

components.name: Notice
components.note: Real and documented, but Storybook flags it use-with-caution: not yet recommended alongside @wordpress/components (gutenberg#76135).

components.name: Popover
components.note: Still the safe, stable choice. @wordpress/ui's Popover exists but is experimental -- not a migration target yet.

components.name: Popover
components.note: Real and documented, but Storybook flags it use-with-caution: not yet recommended alongside @wordpress/components (gutenberg#76135).

components.name: Modal
components.note: Still the safe, stable choice. @wordpress/ui's Dialog/Drawer/AlertDialog exist as its eventual replacements but are all experimental -- not a migration target yet.

components.name: ConfirmDialog
components.note: Still the safe, stable choice for confirmation dialogs. @wordpress/ui's AlertDialog is its eventual replacement but is experimental -- not a migration target yet.

components.name: Dialog
components.note: Real and documented (Root/Trigger/Popup/Header/Title/Description/Content/Footer/Action), but Storybook flags it use-with-caution: not yet recommended alongside @wordpress/components (gutenberg#76135). Eventual Modal replacement.

components.name: AlertDialog
components.note: Real and documented, but Storybook flags it use-with-caution and 'not yet recommended for use alongside @wordpress/components' (gutenberg#76135). Eventual ConfirmDialog replacement, for destructive/irreversible confirmations specifically.

components.name: Drawer
components.note: Real and documented, but Storybook flags it use-with-caution (gutenberg#76135). For editing something already on screen / multi-field / drill-down overlays, as opposed to Dialog's single-decision case.

components.name: Navigator
components.note: Screens are declared flat with path strings and the path is the state — see the navigator-drilldown pattern.

components.name: ItemGroup
components.note: The list container for drilldown rows. Item is its row; a row is one control with one tab stop.

components.name: Composite
components.note: Roving tabindex for a list or grid where one item is selected — one tab stop for the whole set, arrows within it.

components.name: Panel
components.note: Intended for the block inspector sidebar. For a group of optional settings use ToolsPanel; for a collapsible section elsewhere use Collapsible (@wordpress/ui).

components.name: ToolsPanel
components.note: Each ToolsPanelItem declares hasValue / onDeselect / isShownByDefault / panelId; the panel owns resetAll. This is what keeps a twelve-control surface showing three.

components.name: ToggleGroupControl
components.note: The answer for two to five mutually exclusive options that fit on one row. Will be superseded by the @wordpress/ui version, which is not ready yet.

components.name: UnitControl
components.note: A CSS length with its unit, parsed and preserved. A TextControl holding "16px" is not this.

components.name: RangeControl
components.note: Will be superseded by SliderControl in @wordpress/ui, which is not shipped yet. Pair with UnitControl when the value is a CSS length.

components.name: SearchControl
components.note: Will be superseded by the @wordpress/ui version, which is not ready yet.

components.name: SelectControl
components.note: Correct for a long or open-ended list. For two to five options that fit on one row, ToggleGroupControl; for a visual choice, a preview grid or a value-preview row.

components.name: RadioControl
components.note: For a set that fits on one row, ToggleGroupControl reads better and costs less space.

components.name: BaseControl
components.note: Label, help text and id wiring for a composite control you are building out of more than one input.

components.name: ColorIndicator
components.note: The swatch that makes a color row show its value instead of naming it.

components.name: ComboboxControl
components.note: Will be superseded by SearchableSelectControl in @wordpress/ui, which is not shipped yet.

components.name: Disabled
components.note: Wraps a live preview so nothing inside it is focusable or interactive.

components.name: BoxControl
components.note: A fallback for themes that supply no spacing presets. Most of the time SpacingSizesControl is what you want.

components.name: DropdownMenu
components.supersededBy: Menu (@wordpress/components) -- core only; Menu (@wordpress/ui) outside it

components.name: MenuGroup
components.supersededBy: Menu.Group (@wordpress/components) -- core only; Menu (@wordpress/ui) outside it
components.note: Subcomponent of DropdownMenu.

components.name: MenuItem
components.supersededBy: Menu.Item (@wordpress/components) -- core only; Menu (@wordpress/ui) outside it
components.note: Subcomponent of DropdownMenu.
